verifications.claim: Artemis II is the first crewed mission of NASA's Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and Orion capsule.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Coming more than three years after the uncrewed Artemis I test flight, Artemis II will mark the first time humans have traveled beyond low Earth orbit'; R3: 'The approximately 10-day Artemis II mission around the Moon is the first crewed mission of the Artemis program'; R6: 'Artemis II will be the first crewed mission of the Artemis programme'; R7: 'the first crewed flight of the NASA-led Artemis program... Artemis II was the second flight of the Space Launch System (SLS) and the first crewed flight of the Orion spacecraft'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly state Artemis II as the first crewed SLS/Orion mission following uncrewed Artemis I.

verifications.claim: Artemis II is scheduled to launch no earlier than April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'When: April 1 between 6:24 p.m. ET and 8:24 p.m. ET is the next chance'; R4: 'NASA’s Artemis II mission is set to launch on April 1, 2026'; R5: 'launch as soon as Wednesday, April 1'; R7: 'Launch date April 1, 2026'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm April 1, 2026, as the earliest scheduled launch date.

verifications.claim: Artemis II will carry four astronauts around the Moon to test systems for future lunar landings.

verifications.reasoning: Directly matches description of four astronauts, lunar flyby, and testing for future landings.
